title: Certified Verification of Expansion Testing without Connectivity via Lazy-Walk Return Probabilities
abstract: We construct a standalone zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core lazy-walk, finite Cauchy-Schwarz, Dirichlet-energy, trace-gap, integer Bernoulli, induced-expander trimming, balanced-cut farness, non-backtracking polynomial, and three-squares parity theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice) for Nikolas Melissaris (arXiv:2611.32677, Nov 2026), paired with a zero-floating-point exact rational/integer four-mode certificate verifier (EXP-RETPROB-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.180-2.195 ms, total 14.53 ms), all exact lazy-walk return probabilities, Lemma 5.3 trimming maximizers, Lemma 7.3 balanced-cut farness lower bounds, Lemma 7.5 non-backtracking polynomials, and Lemma 7.4 three-squares scaling witnesses replay deterministically while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.
